synthesis.problem_gist: Add instrument-level MAX_LIQUIDATION_QTY for CFD / CFD_FOREX / CFD_STOCK (Confluence CRT-1891, CRT-1785), editable via dxMC, with defaults by CORNER_SUBTYPE (CFD_FOREX_OTC=200, CFD_FOREX_DMA=20 000 000, none for CFD/CFD_STOCK so no default chunking). Margin liquidation splits closing orders when position qty exceeds the cap; opening orders are not limited by this field. Non-trading-hour behavior, simultaneous child orders, completion only when all complete, rejection retries and IN REVIEW per CRT-1126 are in scope per Jira scenario. Port to 270 branch.

requirements.snippet_text: Max order quantity during liquidation, integer. Position should be split by orders with quantity not exceeding max liquidation qty (see LinkLINKCRT-1785)   * all instruments with CFD_FOREX_OTC subtype should have default max liquidation qty = 200 * all instruments with CFD_FOREX_DMA subtype should have default max liquidation qty = 20 000 000
requirements.jira_context: Epic description bullet: introduce max liquidation qty on instrument level (IPF).

requirements.snippet_text: If position quantity exceeds max liquidation quantity (LinkLINKCRT-1891), then several orders should be sent where each order's quantity does not exceed the maximum tradable amount and the final order contains any residual quantity.  The orders should be sent simultaneously.
requirements.jira_context: Epic description: split positions in chunks when max liquidation qty defined.
